title: Unabstracted request input through direct $_GET access
root_cause: The controller reads request input from the $_GET superglobal instead of the PSR-7 request. The value bypasses the request abstraction and Extbase property mapping, so it is untyped and unvalidated at the boundary.

origin.reference: CLAUDE.md, TYPO3 Core APIs (PSR-7 request handling)
origin.note: This rule reports a hardening / best-practice violation rather than an exploitable vulnerability on its own. No advisory maps to it.
